description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for the Notebook entity using Android Room database annotations. It specifies methods for inserting, deleting, updating, and querying Notebook records from the database.

classes.name: NotebookDao
classes.description: An interface providing database access methods for Notebook entities, annotated with @Dao for Room integration.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a Notebook into the database, replacing on conflict, and returns the row ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Notebook objects from the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates one or more Notebook objects in the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Notebook by its ID as a Flow that emits the Notebook or null if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Notebook entries as a Flow emitting a list of Notebooks.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Notebook by its name, limited to one result, as a Flow emitting the Notebook or null.
